question: How spatially localized is species-specific prior strong-chorus memory within a NAAMP route?
population: Physically stable matched pairs with at least one prior eligible run in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum. Focal species are route-new in the wet survey and had occurred somewhere on the route before the focal pair.
unit: pair x focal species x focal physical stop

memory_categories.same_site: The focal species had CallingIndex 2-3 at this same physical SiteID in a prior eligible run.
memory_categories.adjacent_site_only: No same-site prior strong chorus, but the focal species had prior CallingIndex 2-3 at one of the focal route's immediately adjacent StopNumbers (absolute StopNumber difference = 1).
memory_categories.distant_route_site_only: No same-site or adjacent-site prior strong chorus, but the focal species had prior CallingIndex 2-3 at another physical SiteID among the focal route's ten stops.
memory_categories.no_current_route_site_memory: No prior CallingIndex 2-3 at any of the focal route's current ten physical SiteIDs.

nuisance_adjustment: log1p(number of other species with prior CallingIndex 2-3 at the focal SiteID)
number of prior eligible runs in which the focal SiteID was sampled
primary_design: Within pair x species, demean wet_strong and all memory/nuisance predictors. Fit OLS without intercept with route-clustered covariance, using no-current-route-site-memory as the implicit reference.
primary_prediction: Same-site memory coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0 AND the same-site minus adjacent-site coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0.
secondary: Adjacent-site coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0 is interpreted as neighborhood propagation.
Repeat primary model in same-observer pairs.
minimum_gate: At least 500 informative pair x species groups with >=2 memory categories represented among their ten stops, >=250 routes, and >=20 species.
interpretation: A same-site > adjacent contrast supports fine-scale species-specific localization rather than a generic route-wide species effect.
Positive adjacent memory would indicate a broader local neighborhood template.
StopNumber adjacency is route order, not a direct metric distance; no dispersal or individual movement is inferred.
No causal biological-memory or rainfall claim.
